name: Two-Handed Axe — "double its power" means the equipped creature
notes: Found by tests/sweep.py (theme: double its power). 'Whenever equipped creature attacks, double its power until end of turn.' produced nothing. 'its' is rewritten to 'equipped creature's' when the trigger condition names the attached permanent, so the existing attachment redirect sends the effect to the creature wearing the Axe. Hill Giant 3/3 becomes 6/3; the unequipped Bears stay 2/2.

call: double its power until end of turn.
Whenever equipped creature attacks, double its power until end of turn.
